label: Brave Search
description: Privacy-focused web search via the Brave Search API.
notes: Piece has one real action (web_search); the generic custom-API-call helper action was skipped since Agently has a generic HTTP node. The optional numeric 'count' prop was made a required text field (placeholder 10) because the executor cannot conditionally omit query params and Brave rejects an empty count value.
